<function name="PaintWorldTips" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>
Called from <page>GM:HUDPaint</page> to draw world tips. By default, enabling cl_drawworldtooltips will stop world tips from being drawn here.<br/>
See <page>Global.AddWorldTip</page> for more information.

<note>This cannot be used with <page>hook.Add</page></note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
